newsitem.title: FRANCE: Competition body to vet Carrefour GMB move.
newsitem.headline: Competition body to vet Carrefour GMB move.

text.p: Retailer Carrefour's acquisition of a stake in GMB, the holding group of Cora stores, has been sent to the competition authorities for appraisal, a French finance ministry statement said on Monday.
The statement gave no further information beyond saying the ministry had referred the matter to the Competition Council on February 20.
Carrefour bought 41.4 percent of GMT in December, in two blocks of 33.34 percent and 8.1 percent respectively, from GMB family shareholders and said the acquisition had cost it 3.1 billion francs.
Carrefour chief executive Daniel Bernard told Reuters Financial Television in an interview on February 26: "We hope to go further".
"We are already a major shareholder with more than 40 percent. But we cannot decide the group's strategy," he said in the interview.
